title: Maintenance and Housekeeping Standards
canonicalText:
[[PA.1004 | Maintenance and Housekeeping Standards | Applies to: PACE | Revised 03/01/2025]]
<<page 1>>
I. PURPOSE
This policy outlines the procedures for the maintenance and cleanliness at the CalOptima Health
Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE) Center.
II. POLICY
A. CalOptima Health PACE employees shall ensure all CalOptima Health PACE Centers are clean and
  safe for Participants and employees.
III. PROCEDURE
A. Each CalOptima Health PACE Center shall be clean, safe, and in good repair at all times.
  Maintenance shall include provisions for cleaning and repair services which include, but are not
  limited to:
  1. Cleaning of hard services, such as counters, tables, windows, walls, and floors to keep them free
    from accumulation of dirt;
  2. Cleaning of soft surfaces, such as rugs, upholstered furniture, and drapes to keep them free from
    an accumulation of dirt, stains, or odor;
  3. Maintenance of all interior and exterior surfaces;
  4. Maintenance of all buildings, fixtures, and equipment in operable condition;
  5. Maintenance of toilet, hand washing, and bathing facilities in operating condition and free of
    dirt;
  6. Maintenance of heating, air conditioning and ventilating systems in normal operating condition;
  7. Maintenance of all furnishings in good repair; and
  8. Maintenance of grounds in a safe and attractive condition.
<<page 2>>
B. CalOptima Health PACE employees shall either employ or contract for staff to carry out preventive
  maintenance, in accordance with the provisions of this Policy and applicable local and state
  regulations.
C. Maintenance employees shall clean surfaces and disinfect as necessary with proper disinfection and
  cleaning agents.
D. Monitoring
  1. The CalOptima Health PACE Center Manager, or their designee, shall perform inspections to
    ensure cleanliness and regular maintenance of CalOptima Health PACE facilities.
V. REFERENCE(S)
A. CalOptima Health PACE Program Agreement
B. Title 22, California Code of Regulations (C.C.R.), §78507
C. Title 42, Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), § 460.72
<<page 3>>
IX. GLOSSARY
PACE Center: The location designated by CalOptima Health PACE at which Participants shall receive PCP services.
Participant: An individual enrolled in the CalOptima Health PACE program.
